observations.text: Interval between superintendent visits over 7 months as shown in the PIQ. An intermediate audit was not accepted; he went strictly by the PIQ.
Lifeboat lowering into the water done 3 days after the 3 month interval (ship was in a high risk area). Company was not informed. Counted under several categories.
Enclosed space entry checklist did not show top, middle and bottom gas readings, although the SMS required them. Master advised to raise it in the SMS review.
Paint on the edge of one fusible plug on a tank dome. Cleaned in his presence, still recorded.

positives: Crew answered the ESD points question correctly
Bosun completed the breathing apparatus demonstration although he had joined two days earlier
style: Explains the full schedule at the opening meeting and keeps to it
Goes strictly by the PIQ; does not accept other evidence that contradicts it
Repeats the same question in different ways until fully satisfied (hours of rest)
Records an observation even when the defect is fixed in front of him
Asks ratings practical questions and expects specific items (EEBD for enclosed space entry)

questions.q: If hours of rest are exceeded, what is the company procedure and what is the company limit: 2, 3 or 4 non-conformities?
Which week are the chart corrections up to?
What is the difference between two and four colour depth display on ECDIS?
What is CATZOC? What is SCAMIN?
When can you go outside the company UKC policy, and where is that documented?
In rain, which radar do you use, X or S band, and why? What is the difference?
The Bosun shouts on the radio from the forecastle: man overboard starboard side. What do you do?
Explain and start the emergency generator.
How would you launch a liferaft manually?
Show the breathing apparatus checks and put it on.
What PPE is needed to enter an enclosed space?
How many ESD points are on the ship and where are they?
What is simultaneous operations, what is your understanding?
Where is the nearest ESD to the gangway?
What cargo are you carrying and in which tanks?
How do you fight different types of galley fire? How do you use the fixed dry powder system for the fryer?
How do you dispose of used cooking oil?

checks.item: Copies of crew list, class status, port of call list, tank inspection schedule and drill matrix
Defect list accuracy, and company permission for any overdue PMS jobs
Enclosed space entry permits
Crew familiarisation reports, especially for the 2nd Engineer
Last dynamic navigation audit and the auditor's qualifications
Coating reports and tank inspection reports
Bunker checklist: primary and secondary communication with the barge written in
Oil Record Book and Garbage Record Book
Drill records against required intervals
Contingency anchorages, parallel index markers, call Master points, pilot boarding point on the passage plan
Master's standing orders and night orders
Echo sounder alarm setting and test
Steering and control testing marks before departure
Battery room, paint locker, chemical locker, CO2 room
Lifeboat engine started
Emergency generator fuel shut off valve demonstrated
Mooring winch brake settings
Fusible plugs on tank domes
Fire locker and emergency lighting on deck
Loading plan, stability at intervals and calculations
High level alarms not bypassed
Pre-arrival checklist with manifold valve closing times
Galley hygiene and fridges
Random alarms, LO and fuel reports, PMS, log books
Sewage treatment plant and ODME

tips: Check every drill interval before the inspection and tell the company in writing if one will be late
Make sure PIQ dates are correct: he goes strictly by them
Enclosed space checklist must show top, middle and bottom readings, not only the SMS
Write primary and secondary communication with the barge in the bunker checklist (for example VHF and an agreed number of short whistle blasts)
Carry a personal gas detector everywhere on deck rounds
Clean paint off fusible plugs and gauge glasses before the inspection
summary: An eight hour inspection that started with two hours of documents. Nine observations, none high risk. Most came from dates: superintendent visit interval in the PIQ and a lifeboat drill done three days late. He questioned the 2/O in depth on ECDIS and radar, and asked ratings practical safety questions.
